name: Tristian Henderson
strengths: Henderson explodes off the ball with real first-step burst to threaten the tackle’s outside shoulder.
Henderson shows bend to flatten the arc and chase the QB when the pocket collapses.
Henderson stays disciplined in run fit and does not abandon the edge when flow comes his way.
weaknesses: Henderson (6-4 / 217) still needs mass to hold up as an every-down SEC edge versus power tackles.
comparison: Henderson comps to Nik Bonitto — lean 6-4 EDGE who wins with first-step burst and bend before the frame fills into every-down mass.
projection: Henderson projects as develop in the EDGE room, rush in packages early, then compete for a starting JACK/EDGE role — starter upside as he adds 15–20 pounds without losing bend.
schemeFit: Henderson fits a bend-and-burst EDGE/JACK in White’s 3-3-5 who can rush standing up and still set the edge as he fills out.
